clock.title: Clock origin and completion convention
clock.body: Minute0 is09:00 local today. All appointments use this same clock;60 simulated minutes advance one hour. Published closing minutes include the minute itself. A commissioned current check and independent delivery must complete by the applicable closing minute, not merely be requested. Strict before-use consent and before-release prerequisites remain strict.

charter.title: Commission authority and useful completion
charter.body: All people, rules and services are fictional. The owner authorizes the task-specific actions stated in the sources. A useful standing approved substitute is accepted; no optional permission inquiry is mandatory. FINISH is private owner handoff, not another recipient delivery. Useful independent products must actually be produced and held or delivered as commissioned; a project edit does not replace an independent old copy. A production file is immutable; downstream artifacts must use actual prerequisite files. Production inputs are immutable file-ID/SHA audit links; delivery of a derived artifact does not attach the parent body. Declared source-purpose checks recurse through those links. Current-version verification confirms actual holding, not semantic correctness or physical events outside the service.

profile.title: Leonie’s multilingual signs owner voice
profile.body: Leonie writes welcoming service directions with one clear destination and an action a visitor can take. She names translators where their terms call for credit and asks about one actual wording use rather than “all translations”. In operational messages she distinguishes the side a reader stands on from the direction the text is read.

floor.body: Local fictional route rule: commissioned level route must use OPEN edges without stairs, with clear width at least120cm. language.title: Exact approved meaning and wording sources
language.body: Destination meaning is Library desk, not a ticket-only counter or an entrance closure. Owner-owned English phrase: “Library desk”. Luz Spanish phrase “Mesa de biblioteca” has standing sign/print/wayfinding-proof grant with credit “Spanish wording: Luz”. Ana French phrase “Accueil bibliothèque” currently permits private editorial review only, not public sign or print. Optional Ana extension may permit signs/print/current guide with credit. Useful owner-owned approved French substitute “Bureau bibliothèque” preserves the same destination meaning. This local fictional wording policy supplies all translation approvals; no external linguistic judgment is required.

rights.title: Independent language-owner scopes
rights.body: Luz cannot license Ana’s phrase; a whole multilingual file does not merge language ownership. Ana private-review permission is not public/print permission. An accepted French extension authorizes only exact phrase with French wording: Ana credit in these wayfinding products, not unrelated advertising. House French substitute needs no inquiry. Always retain Spanish credit; French house substitute uses “French wording: house”.

fixture.title: Observer and duplex fixture transform contract
fixture.body: Front visitor stands south of pole facing north. Back visitor stands north facing south. Derive each reader-relative mounted arrow from first valid route bearing. Each requested physical sign panel has a directional arrow window; free equivalent wording or text route may accompany but must operate that requested window. Front fixture maps printedLEFT→mountedLEFT and printedRIGHT→mountedRIGHT. Back fixture mirrors horizontally: printedLEFT→mountedRIGHT and printedRIGHT→mountedLEFT. This is the supplied fictional fixture contract, not a claim about general printers. Public/volunteer directions describe mounted reader arrows; printer files must also state actual printed glyph for their own fixture.
